mapper.select:
select c.class_name, c.class_code, u.user_number as `teacherNumber` from classes c left join users u on c.teacher_id = u.id
and c.class_name like concat(#{classesPageQueryDTO.className}, '%')
and c.class_code like concat(#{classesPageQueryDTO.classCode}, '%')
and c.teacher_id in ( select id from users where user_number like concat(#{classesPageQueryDTO.teacherNumber}, '%') )
